headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Jagan demands deployment of Central forces for local body polls in Andhra.
Avoid water intensive crops to avoid financial distress: Telangana MP urges farmers.
Excise department order allowing bakery to stock.
Keralam examining implications of granting deemed-to-be university status for aided colleges.
Government begins process to appoint permanent V-Cs: Higher Education Minister.
bullets_ur: Jagan ne Andhra mein local body polls ke liye markazi afwaj tainat karne ka mutaliba kar diya.
Mali bohran se bachne ke liye zyada pani wali faslon se bachein: Telangana MP ka kisano par zor.
Bakery ko stock rakhne ki ijazat dene ka Excise department ka hukum.
Keralam aided colleges ko deemed-to-be university darja dene ke asraat ka jaiza le raha hai.
Mustaqil V-Cs ki taenati ka amal shuru kar diya gaya: Higher Education Minister.
